svg.title: Trip calendar, August 2026 to July 2027
svg.desc: Twelve-month calendar: funds consolidated 22 August, cat second rabies vaccination 31 August, titer draw mid September, DLD examination 19 October, departure 21 October, Korea to Da Nang early November, DTV application 22 November, visa issued mid December, return to Bangkok around 1 January, the earliest projected Japan entry for the cat on 27 February 2027, and a rabies booster due before leaving Thailand about 25 June 2027.
svg.text: 22 Aug — THB 500,000 consolidated. Seasoning clock starts.
31 Aug — cat's 2nd rabies dose AND titer draw, same visit (MAFF allows same day)
~14 Sep — fallback draw date; every day later slips Japan 1:1
19 Oct — DLD exam + R9 export licence. This is the export step.
21 Oct — depart BKK → ICN. 177 days in Thailand for 2026.
23 Oct — hard cutoff: exemption expires, 179-day tax line
early Nov — Korea → Da Nang (1–3 weeks in Korea)
~mid-Dec — DTV issued (5–15 business days, up to 4 weeks)
30 Dec — earliest tax-clear return (179 days exactly)
1 Jan — RESET. 2026 count closes at 177. New 179-day budget starts at zero.
early Jan — classes begin; 2027 day 1 of the new tax-year count
27 Feb — 🐱 earliest Japan entry: day 180 from a 31 Aug draw. Notify AQS 40 d ahead
31 Mar — day 90: Non-ED initial grant expires; 1st extension due
30 May — 2027 DAY 150: decide whether to pass 179 and accept tax residence
~25 Jun — 🐱 BOOST RABIES before leaving Thailand: covers Spain's 120-d EU window AND autumn Japan
28 Jun — 2027 DAY 179: last non-tax-resident day. DTV grant ends 29 Jun
29 Jul — where a 2nd Non-ED extension would reach, if you stay
